name: What should I prepare before requesting a tub-to-shower conversion quote?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a tub-to-shower conversion quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an estimate, measure your existing bathroom space, inspect surrounding walls for signs of moisture, and decide how you use the room. Note whether you want a zero-threshold barrier-free entry, built-in shampoo niches, bench seating, or grab bars. Check if the home has at least one other bathtub, which is important for future resale value. Having photos of your current setup and an idea of your preferred materials—such as ceramic tile, marble, or prefabricated pans—helps your contractor prepare an accurate preliminary scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Note your bathroom dimensions, choose between tile or acrylic surrounds, decide on accessibility features like benches or grab bars, and confirm if another tub exists in the home.
